guidance: For a named or numbered employee's payroll-related question, including overtime hours or overtime pay, use employeeFile with reportType="payroll", even when the user does not ask for a "report". General or company-wide payroll analytics remain payrollInsights with the appropriate payrollTopic; never use payrollInsights for one employee.
